column18: SpikingGCN competitive accuracy vs SOTA; clear energy advantage on a neuromorphic chip, unquantified
Radar SNN on raw ADC data: 98.1% accuracy, 112 ms processing, over 2x faster than prior state of art
Review of SNN integrated circuits; abstract only covers accelerator energy efficiency in general, no figures
General SNN survey of learning rules and architectures; efficiency only as motivation, no ANN efficiency comparison
SNN review of neuron models, synapses, training, frameworks and vision and robotics applications; no efficiency comparison
SNN within 1.10% and 0.36% of LSTM accuracy with 2x fewer parameters; 10.13x and 11.14x fewer multiplications than GRU
SPLEAT SNN vs CNN on same OPS-SAT FPGA: resources 6.62x lower, power 5.91x lower, equivalent accuracy
Dynamic SNN pruning inspired by dendritic spines: SEW ResNet18 on ImageNet, about 3% loss at 88.8% sparsity
Loihi SNN vs NCS2 DNN: accuracy 99.30 vs 99.93 (alphabet), 99.03 vs 99.76 (digits); power 20.64x, energy 4.10x lower
IMP global pruning of ResNet seed classifier: 92% fewer parameters, accuracy 0.56% above unpruned and 9.17% above layer-wise
Joint NAS and pruning draws lottery tickets from supernets; better accuracy-efficiency trade-offs than NAS and pruning pipelines, no figures
Siamese SNN with EMD loss: F1 up to 0.9386 using about 15% of hidden neurons; non-sparse code 45% slower
BrainScaleS-2 SNN: under one spike per hidden neuron, 85,000 frames/s, under 200 mW; no ANN baseline
SyncNN on Xilinx ARM-FPGA: 99.6% MNIST accuracy, 13,086 fps; similar accuracy and better performance than Vitis AI CNNs
Ternary TCN on CUTIE, 22nm post-synthesis: 94.5% accuracy, 1.7 uJ/inference, 647x lower than prior SNN results
LTH-inspired adaptation of decoder multiplicative parameters in learned video codec; beats VVC in MS-SSIM at low bitrate
Zero-shot pruning to find lottery subnetworks at training time; accuracy versus training complexity trade-off, no figures
Conjecture on permutation invariance and linear mode connectivity; lottery ticket hypothesis only mentioned as implication
SNN designs of varying plausibility on image classification; power, inference time and accuracy trade-offs claimed, no figures or ANN baseline
All-optical SNN mapping by weight partitioning: 58% less energy than unrolling; photonic hardware, no ANN comparison
Few-shot DVS gesture SNN: 84.75% (5-way 1-shot), 92.82% (5-way 5-shot); 60.02% and 58.21% fewer spikes than standard SNN
Neuromodulatory tuning cuts trained parameters four orders of magnitude; analog circuit power below GPU/CPU claimed, no ANN-SNN efficiency figures
Temporal pruning to 1 timestep: VGG16 top-1 CIFAR-10 93.05, CIFAR-100 70.15, ImageNet 69.00; RL with 1-5 timesteps
LSQ-based low-bit and binary SNN quantization: negligible accuracy drop, memory reduction; quantization-only, no pruning
Conversion of ANNs over 100 layers with few time-steps, strong CIFAR and ImageNet accuracy; only time-steps, no ANN efficiency comparison
